body_md:
The UK works with other countries. It is one of five **permanent members** of the UN Security Council and a member of **NATO**, whose members agree to defend each other.

The **Commonwealth** is a voluntary group of countries, most of them once part of the British Empire. The **Council of Europe** created the European Convention on Human Rights.
key_facts: Permanent member of the UN Security Council
Commonwealth: mostly former British Empire countries
Council of Europe: European Convention on Human Rights
